guide.description: Play melodies and drums, shape eight macros and trigger mapped actions over MIDI.

controls.action: Switch on to play melody and drum sounds through the device speaker or your browser. MIDI can play at the same time. Local sound starts off.
Tap Connect USB to send to a connected computer or tablet. Use Other outputs for an external instrument. All messages use channel 1.

Tap higher within a pad for a stronger note. Use the middle for a more even touch. Lift to release. Melody uses a 5×5 grid. Play the scale from left to right, starting at the bottom left and continuing on the row above. Tap the key and scale to change them. The 4×4 drum grid starts at C1 (36).
Turn the four encoders. Tap Macros 1–4 or Macros 5–8 to switch groups (CC20–27). Bind each encoder to its target in Note.
Map Start / Stop, Capture and Undo in Note to CC100, CC101 and CC102. Press sends 127, release sends 0. The encoders and performance keys also work in Root & scale.
